monsters.name: 巨型黄蜂蜂后
monsters.desc: 一只体型像马一样大的身披黄夹克的蜂后，在它的女儿之中如同鹤立鸡群一般。即使它们的腹部长满了卵，翅膀也早已无用，但当它的子民未能制服入侵者时，它自身仍能对入侵者构成威胁。

monsters.name: giant fungal wasp queen
monsters.desc: The head of this colossal queen wasp appears to be attached by only a few slender threads, wobbling precariously as additional tendrils sprout from the silky white exoskeleton.  He

monsters.name: 黄蜂蛹
monsters.desc: 一只黄蜂幼虫，正在蜕变成为一只成年巨型黄蜂。它看起来像一个被一层薄薄的白色薄膜包裹着的奇怪凝结不动的成年体，它的腿和翅膀紧紧地包在巢室里。

monsters.name: oversized wasp queen
monsters.desc: 一只长到了成人的大小的变异黄蜂蜂后，它在其巢穴的纸墙上到处乱爬，并在每一个空巢室中都产下一枚白色的卵。它的体型很难被塞进其中某些巢室之中，但新建的巢室看起来都似乎变得越来越大……

monsters.name: fungal wasp queen
monsters.desc: A mutated wasp queen that has been consumed by a sickly gray mold covering it's body.  Abandoning it's duty to laying eggs, it seemingly searches for anything to attack, as a mist

monsters.name: oversized wasp
monsters.desc: 一只体型有成年猫那么大的巨型黄蜂，黑色的甲壳上长着亮黄色的斑纹，还有一根凶猛的毒刺。它飘忽不定地飞行，寻找着比它更小的猎物。

monsters.name: fungal wasp
monsters.desc: A huge wasp the size of a large cat.  It's bright yellow markings have faded and ripped to show a disgusting mass of mold and rot beneath.  Her wings jut into extremely odd angles,

monsters.name: oversized wasp guard
monsters.desc: 一只变异的巨型黄蜂工蜂，在它的巢穴周围嗡嗡作响。虽然它的觅食蜂姐妹相对而言不爱搭理你，但这只会毫不犹豫地攻击任何它认为对巢穴构成威胁的东西。别在此逗留了。

monsters.name: fungal wasp guard
monsters.desc: A wasp worker split down the middle.  While it's condition looks fatal, it doesn't seem to die, supposedly by the large mushroom growing from once it's wings were.  It's emotionles

monsters.name: 巨型水蝎
monsters.desc: 龙虱的近亲，体形修长，体型长到和人一般大小。在伏击猎物时，它用它的长尾作为通气管。

monsters.name: 水蝎幼虫
monsters.desc: 一只水蝎的若虫，看起来像它父母的缩小版本。

monsters.name: cedar waxwing
monsters.desc: A small species of waxwing with a distinctive feathered crest and a black mask pattern on its face.

monsters.name: gray chick
monsters.desc: A tiny dull-colored chick, it could be from a number of different species.

monsters.name: 黄鼠狼
monsters.desc: 长尾黄鼠狼，虽然体型很小，但是活动范围蔓延到整个欧洲大陆，他不喜欢窝在小洞穴里，而是喜欢猎食其他动物。

monsters.name: whispering fungi
monsters.desc: Large, yellow, coral-like fungi grow from this spot, their spires riddled with intersecting holes.  Despite lack of wind, it seems to wave at a set rhythm, occasionally pulsing out

monsters.name: cottontail rabbit
monsters.desc: A brown-coated cottontail rabbit, with a fluffy white tail.  Its small size and docile nature makes it easy prey for predators, at least the ones that can catch it.  You can't tell

monsters.name: cottontail rabbit kit
monsters.desc: A tiny and very cute cottontail rabbit kit.

monsters.name: 狼
monsters.desc: 一只生活在新英格兰地区的狡猾捕猎者，曾经一度灭绝。但是大灾变让他们成功的恢复了种群数量，有着出色的团队协作捕猎能力。祝你面对它们时还能好运。

monsters.name: 狼崽
monsters.desc: 一只可爱而无助的小狼仔，终有一天会长成一只不再毫无防备且并非可爱的大灰狼。小心它的父母，他们肯定就在附近！

monsters.name: 骷髅狼
monsters.desc: This undead canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.

monsters.name: wood frog
monsters.desc: This frog wears a pattern of tans and browns, with a darker eye mask and a light cream underbelly.  Its coverings make for great camouflage among the dry leaves and tree bark.

monsters.name: 蝌蚪
monsters.desc: This mottled brown tadpole appears rather typical until you can get a glimpse from the side.  Then its high, peaked mouth and low round belly stand out in profile.

monsters.name: many-legged frog
monsters.desc: This cream and brown frog looks more like a great insect in profile.  It has evidently mutated, growing many additional, spindly legs that rise high before attempting to bend back

monsters.name: 巨型潮虫
monsters.desc: 一只体型和狗一般大小的潮虫。这些不起眼的甲壳类动物无害，喜欢潮湿的地方。

monsters.name: woodlouse manca
monsters.desc: 潮虫通过将卵装入育儿袋中并等其长成幼体后再释放来繁殖。除了苍白的颜色，它们的幼虫看起来像是缩小版的成虫。

monsters.name: downy woodpecker
monsters.desc: A small bird with woody colors and a colored crest on its head.  Well known for its ability to poke holes on trees while looking for grubs.

monsters.name: gray chick
monsters.desc: A tiny dull-colored chick, it could be from a number of different species.

monsters.name: giant earthworm
monsters.desc: A huge, mutated garden worm peeking out from the earth - pink, ringed, and most importantly docile.  Despite its size and looks, it appears to be peaceful.

monsters.name: earthworm larva
monsters.desc: A white wriggling worm.

monsters.name: oversized earthworm
monsters.desc: A disturbingly large wriggling earthworm with the moist earth still clinging to its slimy body.  Despite its size it appears to be peaceful, a refreshing change for once.

monsters.name: worm snake
monsters.desc: A small burrowing reptile that's just enjoying its time hunting earthworms.

monsters.name: worm snake snakelet
monsters.desc: A worm snake in its hatchling stage.  Not that much smaller than an adult, actually.

monsters.name: Yrax apeirohedron
monsters.desc: 无数的表面，在闪耀的金色海洋中交错。

monsters.name: Yrax delta
monsters.desc: A kite shaped blade of metal, darting through air and foes by indiscernible means.

monsters.name: Yrax quadraphract
monsters.desc: A gleaming, burnished gold, four legged structure the size of a small vehicle, but much taller; this looks vaguely robotic, but too smooth and perfect to fit in this world.  Its le

monsters.name: quadraphract leg
monsters.desc: A morphing lune of burnished gold attached to the greater structure.  Seemingly jointless it moves with a fluid grace, allowing the quadraphract to glide aboveground with a speed a

monsters.name: Yrax sphenocorona
monsters.desc: Manipulator arrays seamlessly protract from asymmetric facets, their testing spaces undisturbed by the forces affixing it to the sky.

monsters.name: Yrax triakis
monsters.desc: Short-snakelike limbs seamlessly extend from an aggressively faceted body.  Its movements keep it low to the ground, coiled like a trap waiting to spring.

monsters.name: 三琢面
monsters.desc: 三个多足模块与金字塔身体的每个下顶点连接在一起，形成的抽象结构看起来仿佛一只外星昆虫。外表上没有任何人造产物的迹象，它看起来可以将自己折叠成一个完全平平无奇的石英金字塔。它以一种你前所未见的步态爬行，微小的动作让你的眼睛几乎无法辨别出来。

monsters.name: 育格巨噬虫
monsters.desc: A huge, slimy worm-like creature.  Its pale, flattened head drips an oily mucus as it breaches the ground, searching for prey.  Its pinkish mouth opens and closes, revealing long f

monsters.name: 霹雳鼠
monsters.desc: 这只体型和猫一般大小的白化老鼠在任何东西接近它时都会随机发出火花。

monsters.name: 林地幽灵鹿
monsters.desc: 一只肤色苍白、步履蹒跚的白尾鹿，黑色黏液的溪流顺着它的脖子流下来。它的四肢扭动弯曲成奇怪而随意的模样，但充满了非自然的力量和速度。多亏了大灾变，它现在扭转了局面；曾经的猎物，现在自己甚至能够猎杀郊狼、狼和巨型变异蜘蛛。

monsters.name: fungal wight
monsters.desc: This deer's thick fur is spotted with blue orbs that seem to pop and ooze every few minutes, and its rotten skin seems unable to fall off, held together by thick fungal bedding und

monsters.name: zombie reindeer
monsters.desc: 曾经是一只高贵强壮的驯鹿，被丧尸化后已经与圣诞老人的驯鹿大相径庭，只渴望着人类的血肉。

monsters.name: fungal reindeer
monsters.desc: This bumpy, discolored reindeer resembles a malformed Rudolph, its nose having a faintly glowing red fungal sprout.  It'd look almost comical if it wasn't mutilating bodies with it

monsters.name: 恐怖下颚鱼
monsters.desc: 曾经它是一条极富攻击性的饥肠辘辘的牛鲨，它现在丧尸化后看起来更恐怖了，可能是因为它缺乏一个正常运作的大脑的原因吧。

monsters.name: 幽灵虎
monsters.desc: 这只看似正常的老虎走起路来摇摇晃晃的，下巴松弛，眼睛睁得大大的，漆黑的眼睛正闪闪发亮。

monsters.name: tiger fungal wight
monsters.desc: This rotting tiger has lost its stumble, as large fungal bulbs seem to have extended its pawpads thoroughly.  Its head crackles when trying to turn, seemingly stuck facing forward.

monsters.name: zombie llama
monsters.desc: 这只羊驼从许多伤口中渗出黑色液体，皮毛已经和部分皮肤一起脱落，露出跳动的肉块。它的嘴里滴着一种恶心的绿色物质，似乎在咀嚼。

monsters.name: 狰狞狂吠兽
monsters.desc: 一条丧尸化的野狼。它的嘴里流淌着黑色物质，长长的白色獠牙外翻着。

monsters.name: 丧尸熊
monsters.desc: 这只黑熊的眼睛渗出深色油状液体，撕裂的肉体瘢痕累累。它的步伐拖曳蹒跚。

monsters.name: 酸液丧尸熊
monsters.desc: Most of this bear's fur has burnt off and its body looks to be falling apart, not entirely immune to its own acidic fluids.  Despite its weakened state, the strength of a bear hasn

monsters.name: 骸骨丧尸熊
monsters.desc: As if a zombified bear wasn't already a problem, this one is layered in thick bone growths that protect it from harm.  The irregular way the plates grow against each other has some

monsters.name: 丧尸河狸
monsters.desc: 这只长着白星眼的怪兽身体侧面有个巨大伤口，血迹斑斑的肋骨清晰可见。它最突出的特征是一对可怕的门牙和嘴中不断滴下的厚厚的黑色粘液。它看起来不再想要啃树了。

monsters.name: 丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具人类尸体，蹒跚的步伐，黑洞的眼睛潜藏着对血肉无法压抑的狂躁渴望。

monsters.name: 酸液丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只看上去很恶心的丧尸。它的皮肤看上去非常薄，你都能看到它的血管下流动着粘稠的黄色液体。

monsters.name: dusted acidic zombie
monsters.desc: This acrid smelling moving corpse has been covered with a thick gray powder.

monsters.name: fungalizing acid zombie
monsters.desc: This sickly looking moving corpse with prominent yellow veins has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: 小不点啃蚀者
monsters.desc: 这个可怕的小型变异怪胎看上去曾经是一个小孩，但其巨大的大颚让它看上去更像一只食肉的野兽。

monsters.name: 装甲丧尸
monsters.desc: 尽管被包裹在一台几乎无法穿透的战斗机甲之中，但还是有什么东西杀死了这个士兵。

monsters.name: 流涎啃蚀者
monsters.desc: 一个扭曲而膨胀的人体。它的颌已经延长的如同鳄鱼的长吻一般，滴落着恶臭的唾液。

monsters.name: bonecrushing biter
monsters.desc: A thick ridge of muscle bulges from this zombie's neck, and its short, broad jaws hang low against its chest.  Once it clamps onto something, it braces to bite down harder.

monsters.name: splitjaw biter
monsters.desc: This zombie's long lower jaw is split down the middle.  The two halves splay as it opens its mouth and clamp inward as it bites.

monsters.name: 无脑丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只除了面部和头骨被完全毁坏之外，与其它丧尸差不多的丧尸。虽然原因不明，但在一团血肉模糊中，你能看到它失去了脸和大脑，只有耳朵还算完整。

monsters.name: bruiser zombie
monsters.desc: This zombie's right arm has been grotesquely deformed into a massive mace-like shape.  What remains of its hand has been covered in spiky bone, and the upper arm's skin is clearly

monsters.name: 狂暴丧尸兽
monsters.desc: 一个肌肉发生了突变的巨型丧尸，浑身上下都是畸形的巨型肌肉与肿胀化脓的伤口，手臂力量之大足以将人击飞很远，非常危险。

monsters.name: dusted brute zombie
monsters.desc: This zombie's entire body bulges with distended muscles heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

monsters.name: fungal brute
monsters.desc: This bulky fungal construct seems to have lost all facial features, its chest and face covered in thick fungal sprouts.  Its arms and legs are grotesquely swollen.

monsters.name: fungal stalk brute
monsters.desc: This inhumanly muscular corpse has numerous festering wounds and has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: 摔跤手丧尸
monsters.desc: A slab of festering muscle the size of a well-toned bodybuilder.  With popping and cracking sounds its arm muscles constantly lengthen and contract as it reaches out with deformed

monsters.name: 丧尸夜魔
monsters.desc: 一具不知何故像某种恶灵一样躲在黑暗之中的巨型丧尸，体型庞大但其行动十分敏捷。

monsters.name: 放电丧尸兽
monsters.desc: A huge beast covered in visible scarring from the lightning bolts that arc out of its body.  Being near it, you can hear a slight humming, like that of an electrical transformer.

monsters.name: mummified zombie
monsters.desc: This zombie's skin has been preserved and appears almost living, but its drawn visage, corded muscles, and bulging eyes leave no mistake that it is undead.  Its ceremonial-looking

monsters.name: 石像鬼丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸的手臂长度已经伸长得超出了人类的极限，上面覆盖的表皮被拉伸成了可怕的肉质薄膜。其余的身体部分变得十分瘦弱，细绳样的肌肉撕破紧绷的血肉。虽然它看上去并不能真正飞行，但它能用自己变异的手臂在空中惊人地快速跳跃。

monsters.name: 儿童丧尸
monsters.desc: 它只是一个孩子，现在除了眼中的饥饿，外表没有什么不同了。你在杀死它时很难摆脱自己是在杀死一个真正的孩子的感觉。

monsters.name: 儿童丧尸
monsters.desc: 它只是一个孩子，现在除了眼中的饥饿，外表没有什么不同了。你在杀死它时很难摆脱自己是在杀死一个真正的孩子的感觉。

monsters.name: dusted zombie child
monsters.desc: This small, stumbling child has been dusted with a thick gray powder.  Something about the way it moves is uncanny.

monsters.name: fungal stalk child
monsters.desc: This child moves slowly, as though sleepy.  A short stalk of gray fungus has burst from the top of the little head.

monsters.name: 真菌儿童
monsters.desc: 一只真菌生物，很难认出这曾经是一个人类儿童。霉菌几乎覆盖住了它全部的皮肤，身体遍布裂痕穿孔，无数细小的菌丝在其中穿插蠕动。

monsters.name: scorched zombie child
monsters.desc: A diminutive humanoid figure, its body ravaged by fire into a blackened, charred shell.  Its leathery flesh has mended in patches, and the tattered clothing is still clinging to it

monsters.name: 警察丧尸
monsters.desc: 一个曾经是警察的丧尸，身上披着经历了风吹雨打而受损严重的防暴装备，目光不再紧盯着昔日的罪犯，而是在搜索鲜活的肉体。

monsters.name: 腐蚀丧尸
monsters.desc: This zombie has swollen to immense proportions, but still manages to hold itself together with semi-congealed acid all over its bloated, leathery body.  It moves clumsily, but spit

monsters.name: 爬行丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具只靠着上肢缓慢地爬行的人类尸体，而它的下肢已经腐坏得原形崩坏了。

monsters.name: dusted crawling zombie
monsters.desc: This moving corpse with badly damaged legs has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

monsters.name: fungal zombie crawler
monsters.desc: This fungal monster struggles to move as bulbous mushrooms grow from its exposed back.  Its leg seems to be wrapped in sturdy tendrils, and its arms visibly swell and pop gruesomel

monsters.name: fungal stalk crawler
monsters.desc: This moving corpse with badly damaged legs has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: 化蛹爬行丧尸
monsters.desc: 这半具人类尸体自脖子以下的一切都被一种黑色粘稠的纤维包裹着。在其下方有什么东西正在有规律的不停搏动，看上去十分怪异。

monsters.name: 化蛹爬行丧尸
monsters.desc: 这半具人类尸体自脖子以下的一切都被一种黑色粘稠的纤维包裹着。在其下方有什么东西正在有规律的不停搏动，看上去十分怪异。

monsters.name: 恐怖爬行者
monsters.desc: 曾经是个小孩，但现在已经成了变异怪兽，有着发黑的表皮及巨大的眼睛。这可憎的邪恶生物就是对其人类起源的嘲弄。

monsters.name: 受困触手
monsters.desc: 一只血肉和尖骨组成的巨型触手。它从破损的地面的一个缝隙中伸出，缝隙之下无数的人类残肢在怪异的甲壳下不停蠕动，希望重获自由。虽然这只触手已经无比巨大，你仍然确信这只是一只更大生物的一部分，因为当触手移动时，你能感觉到整个废墟的震动，如同一只未知的巨人正在与它的混凝土坟墓抗争。

monsters.name: 丧尸犬
monsters.desc: 一具变形的犬类尸体，现在已经复活。这只怪兽肌肉发达，能够轻易追赶上它的两条腿的“朋友”。

monsters.name: 酸尸犬
monsters.desc: 残缺扭曲、不堪入目的犬类活尸。怵目惊心的黄涎从其嘴中滴落。

monsters.name: 脓疱恐兽
monsters.desc: 身上覆盖多处恶臭脓疱的巨犬。腐蚀性液体从其狰狞的口中溢出。

monsters.name: fungal dog
monsters.desc: The deformed, animated, and again reanimated corpse of a what looked like the concept of a canine.  It has lost almost all of its dog-like features, except for its constant aggress

monsters.name: dusted zombie
monsters.desc: This shambling corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

monsters.name: 循声者丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸的头很明显曾经被摧毁过，它脸上的裂口充满了一种特殊的灰色粘液。人类的耳朵从侧面垂下，巨大而令人恶心。眼睛前的狭缝表明它还可能还保留着一定的视力。

monsters.name: 放电丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具身体呈现淡蓝色的丧尸，由于生化插件的异常放电，其周围不断有噼啪的电流环绕。

monsters.name: 肥胖丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只身体脂肪层发生了变异的肥胖丧尸，它臃肿的尸体踉跄着，吞下的恶心食物在胃中腐烂，散发着浓烈的恶臭，空洞的黑色眼眶扫视四周。

monsters.name: dusted fat zombie
monsters.desc: This heavy moving corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

monsters.name: fungal stalk feeder
monsters.desc: This heavy corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: fungal feeder
monsters.desc: Thousands upon thousands of fungal bulbs, sprouts and tendrils jut out from every angle of this walking carcass.  Large patches of yellow pulsating mold seem to be growing in the z

monsters.name: 恶魔丧尸
monsters.desc: A monstrous burnt vaguely humanoid creature, walking around on its knuckles like a gorilla.  Tattered and blackened strands of muscle fibers dangle all around its body, with patche

monsters.name: scorched zombie brute
monsters.desc: An oversized charred human form.  The remains of its burnt and blackened musculature are clearly visible between the cracks of the shell formed from its melted skin.  This one appe

monsters.name: 消防员丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具穿着破烂消防装备的腐败人体，漫无目的地蹒跚着，散发着毒瘴与腐烂的气息。它戴着的防护面具让它没法试图咬你。

monsters.name: fireproof zombie
monsters.desc: This zombie appears to have once been a firefighter or similar first responder, the wilted remains of its turnout gear clinging to it like a molted carapace.  Fibrous streaks resem

monsters.name: fireproof brute
monsters.desc: This zombie appears to have once been a firefighter or similar first responder, but the uniform is hardly recognizable at this point, as the thing has grown new flesh and muscle ov

monsters.name: fireproof grappler
monsters.desc: This zombie appears to have once been a firefighter or similar first responder, its body having ripped through and absorbed the majority of its uniform.  Its torso and back are swo

monsters.name: fungal stalk zombie
monsters.desc: This writhing corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: 真菌丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具曾是人类的尸体，现在完全变成了怪物。真菌从它的口、眼、耳和其他孔洞处喷薄而出并互相连接起来，被霉菌覆盖的躯体还在蹒跚而行。

monsters.name: acidic fungal zombie
monsters.desc: A grotesque fusion of rot and mycelium, this zombie's flesh is pocked with open sores that lazily drool a strange yellow-green acid.  Pale fungal stalks have burst through its corr

monsters.name: fursuited zombie
monsters.desc: A human body, swaying awkwardly in a torn cloth suit of an anthropomorphized animal.  Black goo and blood cakes the suit, and it gives off a foul, rotting odor.

monsters.name: 胀气丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具灰白的皮肤下充满了臌胀的腐败气体的尸体，隆起的皮肤遍布着黑色的血管，随时都可能爆出大量毒气。

monsters.name: 坏疽爬行者
monsters.desc: 一只噩梦般的蛛形怪物，由人类血肉变成。它敏捷地在墙壁和天花板上爬行，断离的肋骨构成了它的肢体。

monsters.name: 真菌胀气丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只真菌丧尸肿胀的灰白皮肤上长满了厚厚的真菌，如同气球一般隆起，随时都有可能爆炸变成一团孢子云。

monsters.name: 坏疽肉块
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸的灰色皮肤上布满了严重的伤口，在腐败气体的压力下几乎就要爆炸。在不可辨认的血肉之中，一个人类头颅用空洞的黑色眼珠注视着你的行动。

monsters.name: 坏疽穿刺者
monsters.desc: 这个尸体以骇人的方式扭曲，变成了昆虫一般的形状。从它的胸腔之中伸出了一只中空的触手。

monsters.name: 痉挛肉块
monsters.desc: 一大团融合在一起的尸体和变异血肉。它不断痉挛，如同心率失常的心脏病人般绝望地搏动。

monsters.name: zombie goat
monsters.desc: The moving corpse of what once was a goat is now left stumbling around, with pitch black empty eyes, looking for anything alive to kill.

monsters.name: 肉钩丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只严重畸形的丧尸。它的四条胳膊像没有皮的猿猴四肢一样枯瘦，一边在身体四周晃悠，一边盲目的摸索着四周。

monsters.name: 长臂丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸在移动时，两条长长的手臂沿着地面拖动。肿胀的后背看上去就像是驼背了，肩膀上的肌肉也从撕破的皮里露出来。

monsters.name: zombie prowler
monsters.desc: Enveloped in darkness is the outline of what used to be a person, quick and spindly - and nigh invisible in the shadows.  Even with the unnatural camouflage hiding its features you

monsters.name: 锈拳丧尸兽
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸兽身上覆盖着生锈的金属破片。大块的金属砸穿了它的手臂，并融合成了锤子一样的形状。

monsters.name: 吊挂内脏
monsters.desc: 一大块巨大的蛇形血肉从天花板悬吊下来，疯狂地四处摔打着，四处搜寻猎物。

monsters.name: 防化员丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸被完全包裹在防护服中，显然这无法保护它免受感染。至少它没法从防护服里面咬你。

monsters.name: 变形丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸黝黑阴森的眼窝中空无一物，然而你却能感到它在巡视着周围。它的身体以一种原来主人永远无法达到的姿势卷曲变幻、辗转腾挪。在布满黑色血管的躯体上，唯一看起来还结实的是那一排尖锐而漆黑的獠牙。你有一种感觉，那东西唯一能算是人体的东西就是剩下的那层皮，就像你穿着你的衣服那般。

monsters.name: 丧尸马
monsters.desc: 这匹丧尸马有着可怕的外表，从它突出的肋骨、发白的头骨、腐朽破烂的肌肉来看，它似乎无法进行太多的战斗，但它变异后的力量让它变得更加强大。黑色发臭的体液从伤口上缓缓滴下。

monsters.name: 饥荒之马
monsters.desc: 这匹不死的马的皮肤像煤灰一样焦黑，布满了伤口和洞。呛人的黑烟柱从伤口处涌出，熏死了靠近的一切。

monsters.name: rotten fungal horse
monsters.desc: This hulking horse-figure seems to re-learn galloping with every step, as large fungi cling and sprout off of its mane.  It travels towards anything moving, even though in the cent

monsters.name: 死亡之马
monsters.desc: With plates of asymmetrical bone tissue overlapping its body, this ignoble steed needs no rider for you to fear its approach.  Completing its ghoulish look is an overgrown skull wh

monsters.name: 战争之马
monsters.desc: 一匹没有皮肤的丧尸马，过度生长的血淋淋肌肉组织清晰可见。当它冲向目标时，一些肌肉偶尔会从肌腱上撕裂，像一条松散的软管一样甩来甩去，然后再织回原处。

monsters.name: acidic zombie horse
monsters.desc: 这匹曾经雄伟的马腹部已经变得臃肿，以至于你可以透过皮肤，看到里面的腐蚀性巨大胆囊。它的脖子也同样变粗，而且比正常情况下略长。

monsters.name: 丧尸浩克
monsters.desc: 一个全身肌肉都发生了变异的超大块头丧尸，体型约为六个人大小，双臂极为强壮，力量之大足以击碎墙壁，愤怒的破坏欲支配着它粉碎着所能见到的一切，极为危险。

monsters.name: dusted zombie hulk
monsters.desc: This zombie's muscular body has swollen to six times the size of an average person and has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

monsters.name: fungal hulk
monsters.desc: This inhumanly warped and swollen fungal construct is entirely covered in thick fungal sprouts.  The body shape is still roughly humanoid but the size is too large, about the size

monsters.name: fungal stalk hulk
monsters.desc: This enormous muscular corpse has swollen six times larger and has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: 狩猎者丧尸
monsters.desc: 你几乎无法相信这个怪物曾经是人类；它用四肢在地上爬行，指甲和牙齿都如同矛尖一般锋利。

monsters.name: lurking spectre
monsters.desc: What might have once been a human is now massive and lanky, its digits and limbs oddly stretched, its shoulders hunched.  It is bathed in a dark shadow, except for its swollen gray

monsters.name: pallid master
monsters.desc: This humanoid floats along, only its toes dragging along the ground.  Its features are swollen, soft, and alien, lacking the proportions and rigidity you would expect of a living p

monsters.name: 凯夫拉丧尸
monsters.desc: This zombie dons a uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  Peculiarly, the uniform seems to have fused to its skin in certain places, its flesh gripping the edges of it

monsters.name: Kevlar brute
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸曾经穿着一种缝有重型防弹材料的制服。但现在已经看不出是什么制服了：怪物的外皮已经覆盖在原有织物上，将制服撕裂成碎片，把剩下的凯夫拉装甲和其他防弹材料变成了它的一部分。同样的，它的双手也融合成了巨大的厚皮棍棒。

monsters.name: 凯夫拉浩克
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸曾经穿着一种有重型防弹材料夹层的制服，但现在它已经长成了一只巨大的厚皮怪物，它变异的皮肤呈现出一种奇怪的纹理，类似于嵌入其中的凯夫拉甲块。它的手臂扭曲成了巨大的畸形骨头棒，在它身后拖行。

monsters.name: 警卫丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只摇摇欲坠的丧尸，穿着灰色制服和前面印有"保安"字样的防弹背心。看起来这位警卫死前身体体质不错；它的移动步伐迅速有力，尽管动作笨拙。

monsters.name: lashing zombie
monsters.desc: This zombie has very elongated arms.  While they're menacingly long, they seem quite thin and floppy, as if they lack bones.

monsters.name: 肉山
monsters.desc: 一大团体积巨大的变异肉体。它看起来像是某种巨型生物的内脏，表面覆盖着纤细血管构成的网络。

monsters.name: 类鱼丧尸
monsters.desc: 首先入眼的是一张鳄鱼般的大嘴和外突的牙齿，这种穿着泳衣的丧尸潜伏在水里。

monsters.name: zombie marine
monsters.desc: Dressed head to toe in naval combat equipment and with Marine insignia embroidered on its gear, this lurching corpse still retains its physical fitness in death.  From underneath i

monsters.name: naval boarding party zombie
monsters.desc: The torn combat uniform on this corpse identifies it as a former member of a Royal Canadian Navy boarding party.

monsters.name: Mexican marine zombie
monsters.desc: An insignia on the remains of this corpse's uniform marks it as an infantry member of the Armada de México.

monsters.name: bestial stalker
monsters.desc: Lumbering about on all fours, this mutated beast's dagger-like claws clack against the ground as it predatorially moves: thick strands of exposed muscle tissue running across its r

monsters.name: bestial stalker
monsters.desc: This clawed creature stalks on all fours, dragging scraps of a Royal Canadian Navy combat uniform.

monsters.name: bestial stalker
monsters.desc: This clawed creature stalks on all fours, dragging scraps of a Mexican naval infantry uniform.

monsters.name: 丧尸主宰
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸的五官风干收紧，它的嘴唇回缩让它露出不自然的诡异笑容，暴露出在它炯炯有神的大眼睛下方的一排黝黑发亮的牙齿。它体型庞大，移动起来流畅而又如同经过严密控制一般。它周围的空气弥漫着一股危险的气息，而照落在它身上的光线似乎变得更明亮刺眼。

monsters.name: 医生丧尸
monsters.desc: 这具蹒跚而行的尸体穿着得像个医学专家。要么它曾经真的是医生，要么就是它在电视上演过一个。

monsters.name: 酸医丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具医生或护士的尸体，具体是哪种，看不出来。它的大部分衣服已经被分泌出的恶心酸液腐蚀掉了。

monsters.name: 医生丧尸兽
monsters.desc: 或许它曾经是某种医生，但它的制服已经被身上硕大的肌肉撕碎了。

monsters.name: 化蛹丧尸
monsters.desc: 这具人类尸体自脖子以下的一切都被一种黑色粘稠的纤维包裹着。在其下方有什么东西正在有规律的不停搏动，看上去十分怪异。

monsters.name: regenerating zombie medic
monsters.desc: 一个被不明原因变成丧尸的行医者，身上粉红色肌肉蜿蜒着，在伤口上编织。

monsters.name: 军装丧尸
monsters.desc: 这个不死士兵浑身穿着制式军装。以丧尸的标准来说，它的行动相当稳健。

monsters.name: 飞行员丧尸
monsters.desc: Once a pilot, it is wearing a flight suit and a sturdy-looking flight helmet.  The head twitches and adjusts constantly, following any and every source of movement.

monsters.name: 矿工丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸的脸、手、工作服和矿工头盔上全是煤尘的污渍。

monsters.name: 死灵法尸
monsters.desc: 一具被扭曲得变形的人形丧尸，十分瘦弱，有着乌黑的皮肤和发光的红色瞳孔，看着它让你感到莫名的痛苦，仿佛唤醒你内心深处的恐惧，甚至连周围的空气都似乎变得更恶毒，更黑暗，更危险了。

monsters.name: 死灵爆汁丧尸
monsters.desc: 初看上去这只怪物看起来只不过是一个怪异而油腻的空壳，浑身肿胀，许多深黑色的脓疱刺破了它的表皮。当你走近它时，它的眼睛发出了红光并露出了痛苦的怪笑；它的皮肤撕裂开，内脏充满了无与伦比的繁殖力，它的目光激发了你对它那广大无边而又非人般狂喜的恐惧。

monsters.name: 浩克追猎者
monsters.desc: 一只体型肿胀到有六个人大小的巨型丧尸。它墨黑的眼睛紧盯着你。不管你跑多远，它似乎总能找到你。

monsters.name: Nomex zombie
monsters.desc: This zombie was a firefighter in its past life, still donned in its turnout equipment - said equipment has melded with its flesh, with the tough, flame resistant fibers becoming in

monsters.name: 电炽躯壳
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸如今仅剩下一个发光的白色轮廓，你必须眯着眼睛才能透过那如同心跳一般一闪一闪的电场看见它的身影。它慢悠悠地走着，身体四周缠绕的闪电急切地扑向所能触及的任何导电物体。

monsters.name: ocular zombie
monsters.desc: This otherwise-regular zombie's head is absolutely filled to the brim with eyes, half of them frantically swiveling in their orbits.  The other half are staring directly at you.

monsters.name: 军官丧尸
monsters.desc: 这具不死丧尸身穿海军军官的破碎蓝色制服，显然是一名级别更高的海员。很可能由于没有及时穿上防弹衣，结果现在你面前蹒跚而行：可怕的伤口暴露在空气中，大部分血肉从闪闪发光的骨架上被撕碎垂落下来。

monsters.name: paramilitary zombie
monsters.desc: Wearing military surplus gear including an armored vest with patches of local militias, cartoon women, obscene statements, or local political groups.  This person definitely though

monsters.name: 相位复仇者
monsters.desc: 一具迷失在传送门风暴中的研究者的遗骸，被暗藏的某种肉眼不可见的存在扭曲和削弱。它依靠四只布满骨头的尖刺不自然地滑行，它的每一个动作都留下一道充满了扭曲能量的光环。

monsters.name: 相位潜行者
monsters.desc: What remains of a researcher lost to the portal storms, twisted and enervated by the presences that lurk beneath natural perception.  It walks and stumbles in a stuttered manner, a

monsters.name: 溃烂野猪
monsters.desc: 一种从野猪驯化而来的杂食动物，不过现在已经丧尸化了。它鼻子上通常全是泥巴的位置现在满是黑色粘液。

monsters.name: 壕沟野猪
monsters.desc: 滚滚的黄色气云不断地从一只隐隐若现的野猪形阴影上散发出来。这只偶尔出现的丧尸野猪很快被它尸体上数道开放伤口中释放出的气体掩盖起来。

monsters.name: 锈甲丧尸
monsters.desc: 丧尸皮肤破裂处露出的金属破片，如同交织于皮下的甲胄。在锈迹消退之处可以看到黑色的污泥。

monsters.name: 捕猎者丧尸
monsters.desc: 它四肢的关节以奇怪的角度弯折，但是这只人型生物仍能以惊人的速度飞快移动。它的牙齿和手臂都磨成了尖刺型，身上深可见骨的伤口缓缓地流出着黑色的软泥。

monsters.name: 囚犯丧尸
monsters.desc: 显然，当大灾变来临时这只丧尸正在狱中服刑。它穿着黑白条纹的囚衣，腐烂的皮肤上刻有纹身。

monsters.name: prisoner zombie brute
monsters.desc: 这只肌肉发达的丧尸穿着黑白条纹的囚服。

monsters.name: fat prisoner zombie
monsters.desc: 这只肥胖丧尸穿着黑白条纹的囚服。

monsters.name: tough prisoner zombie
monsters.desc: 这只外貌凶猛的丧尸穿着黑白条纹的囚服。

monsters.name: 化蛹丧尸
monsters.desc: 这具人类尸体自脖子以下的一切都被一种黑色粘稠的纤维包裹着。在其下方有什么东西正在有规律的不停搏动，看上去十分怪异。

monsters.name: 化蛹丧尸
monsters.desc: 这具人类尸体自脖子以下的一切都被一种黑色粘稠的纤维包裹着。在其下方有什么东西正在有规律的不停搏动，看上去十分怪异。

monsters.name: 暗影化蛹丧尸
monsters.desc: 怪诞的阴影笼罩着这个生物。你可以看出曾经为人的隐约轮廓，但轮廓边缘处规律的鼓胀，却不是人体结构能办到的。

monsters.name: 化蛹丧尸
monsters.desc: 这具人类尸体自脖子以下的一切都被一种黑色粘稠的纤维包裹着。在其下方有什么东西正在有规律的不停搏动，看上去十分怪异。

monsters.name: 暗影化蛹丧尸
monsters.desc: 怪诞的阴影笼罩着这个生物。你可以看出曾经为人的隐约轮廓，但轮廓边缘处规律的鼓胀，却不是人体结构能办到的。

monsters.name: 饥渴扮演者
monsters.desc: 这具蹒跚而行的尸体穿着破烂老旧的士兵制服。要么它曾经是位历史重演爱好者，要么就是丧尸也学会了时间旅行。

monsters.name: 再生丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只浑身无毛的丧尸。它浑身上下的淡粉色血肉似乎在不停蠕动，很快覆盖并修复它所受的任何伤口。它的衣服上布满了枪眼，表明有人试图干掉它，但失败了。

monsters.name: regenerating abomination
monsters.desc: This zombie hardly resembles a human anymore - Its skeleton has been repeatedly dismantled and reassembled into a horrid quadrupedal shape, like some sort of mismatched action figu

monsters.name: fleshy hunter
monsters.desc: A zombie prowling around on all fours; its exposed muscles churn and snake, unraveling before restitching themselves elsewhere along its red-raw figure.

monsters.name: 梦游丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸的肚子被某种蓝色的、奇怪的甜味气体撑得鼓鼓胀胀的。它走起路来比普通丧尸更加跌跌撞撞，仿佛喝醉了一般。

monsters.name: 保镖丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只强壮的丧尸身上穿着残留的破烂保安制服。

monsters.name: 时髦丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸非常时髦并且衣着暴露。

monsters.name: 丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具人类尸体，蹒跚的步伐，黑洞的眼睛潜藏着对血肉无法压抑的狂躁渴望。

monsters.name: 腐朽丧尸
monsters.desc: A once-dead human corpse.  Its discolored, swollen flesh is riddled with festering wounds and open sores.  It smells indescribably awful.

monsters.name: zombie plaguebearer
monsters.desc: The skin of this walking corpse glistens with disturbing fluids.  Even at a distance, the smell nearly makes you gag.

monsters.name: dusted decayed zombie
monsters.desc: This badly decayed corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

monsters.name: fungal rotter
monsters.desc: The rotten skin that flakes from the host's body seems to be covered in tiny blue dots; occasional popping and crackling sounds are heard, like cracking wood.  This corpse can't be

monsters.name: fungal stalk rotter
monsters.desc: This badly decayed corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: decayed grasper
monsters.desc: A once-dead human corpse, moving despite seeming like it could fall apart into putrescence at any moment.  It slowly crawls along the ground with an eerily-fluid motion.

monsters.name: 追猎者丧尸
monsters.desc: 这个刚复活不久的丧尸跑得很快，它的头神经质一样的前后不断晃动并啮咬自己的手。

monsters.name: dusted zombie runner
monsters.desc: This recently-risen body has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder, but still moves quickly.

monsters.name: fungal runner
monsters.desc: Fungal sprouts seem to support the host's broken legs like crude splints.  Even with its eyes shrouded with tiny spores, it darts towards anything that seems to move in a small rad

monsters.name: fungal stalk runner
monsters.desc: This recently-risen body has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.  This appears to slow it down in some way.

monsters.name: 锈铁丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸浑身上下穿刺着无数覆盖着厚厚铁锈的金属碎片，碎片上的铁锈似乎已经扩散到了尸体的其他部位。你不记得上次注射破伤风疫苗是什么时候了，所以最好不要让它碰你。

monsters.name: 水手丧尸
monsters.desc: Still dressed in the ragged remains of deep blue naval fatigues, it's clear that this walking corpse was once a sailor of some description.  The US Navy's insignia is embroidered o

monsters.name: 研究员丧尸
monsters.desc: The remaining protective gear, laboratory equipment, and long, formerly white labcoat tell you that this zombie was some kind of researcher before turning.

monsters.name: 利剪蛛
monsters.desc: 一团如同梦魇般的蜘蛛形状的血肉高高地矗立在废墟中，无声地守护着眼前残破的景色。它细长的骨头四肢以难以置信的速度在瓦砾中滑动。

monsters.name: 烧焦丧尸
monsters.desc: A heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred meat.  Its now leathery flesh has mended into patches, giving it a more armored appearance.

monsters.name: scorched zombie brute
monsters.desc: An oversized charred human form.  The remains of its burnt and blackened musculature are clearly visible between the cracks of the shell formed from its melted skin.

monsters.name: scorched lasher
monsters.desc: A heavily burned corpse with unnaturally long arms dragging behind it as it moves.  The burnt scar tissue covering it gives it a mildly armored appearance.

monsters.name: 烧焦丧尸
monsters.desc: A heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred meat.  Its now leathery flesh has mended into patches, giving it a more armored appearance.  This one appears to have metal frag

monsters.name: 尖啸丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具瘦弱的尸体，它的胸口已经肿胀，浸透了类似某种试剂的液体。一种浓稠漆黑的软泥正从它张大的口中滴落下来。

monsters.name: 暗影丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只被一层不可思议的阴影所笼罩的丧尸，可能变异出了可以折射光线的表皮，看上去似如光线也拒绝去接触它一般。你唯一能够分辨出来的是一个步履蹒跚的人形轮廓。

monsters.name: zombie sheep
monsters.desc: This sheep's once pure white wool is now barely hanging by its rotten flesh, held together by dried mud and blood.  Its legs now buckle as the rotten muscles have a hard time susta

monsters.name: 锈壳丧尸
monsters.desc: 锈蚀的锯齿状金属破片融合进丧尸的血肉中并取代了部分脊椎。

monsters.name: 尖叫丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具细长的人体，胸部有一个大洞，下巴已经不见了。

monsters.name: 小尖叫丧尸
monsters.desc: 这个严重变异的儿童丧尸移动时四肢四处抽搐，看着如同痉挛疼痛一般。

monsters.name: 颅骨丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸的头是一个可怕的灰色头骨，由人类的骨头碎片和某种粘液组成。当它活动下颚时你能看到锯齿状的牙齿，相当令人不安。它的眼睛裸露在眼窝里，死死盯着你。它的肉质耳朵有正常的四倍大，在自身重量的作用下下垂。

monsters.name: 烟雾丧尸
monsters.desc: 一个黑色扭曲的丧尸，肉块挂在其身上，不停地发出阴霾的黑烟。

monsters.name: dusted smoker zombie
monsters.desc: This smoke-shrouded corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder lighter in color than smoke and ash.

monsters.name: fungal stalk smoker
monsters.desc: This smoke-shrouded corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: 授粉丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只扭曲的布满真菌的丧尸的每一次呼吸都喷射出一片孢子尘，使它看起来就像是从迷雾中诞生一般。

monsters.name: 小鼻涕虫丧尸
monsters.desc: 这孩子是一个肿肿的，粘稠的变异怪物。即使是按丧尸的标准，看起来也很糟糕。也许这就是为什么它似乎如此严重的想要一个拥抱。

monsters.name: 士兵丧尸
monsters.desc: 一个曾经是一名军人的丧尸，从头到脚包裹着战斗服，隐藏在基因里的本能与尚存的肌肉记忆使其比普通丧尸更加可怕。

monsters.name: 胆汁士兵丧尸
monsters.desc: This staggering soldier wears a burnt gas mask, now fused to its face.  Through the melted, bile-encrusted ruination of the mask protrudes some sort of hardened, fleshy proboscis,

monsters.name: 酸液士兵丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸穿着一件看起来曾经是士兵制服和盔甲的东西，现在已经变成了几块破裂融化的金属板，融到了它外表的厚皮之中。它的脸和胳膊被变异血管涨破，酸液不断随着血管的跳动滴落在地上。

monsters.name: 黑雾丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只士兵丧尸的皮肤散发出一种模糊的烟雾，模糊了它的轮廓，使得它的伪装在背景下更加难以察觉。在黑暗中，几乎看不见它。

monsters.name: 猎杀者丧尸
monsters.desc: 身上残留的制服碎片表明这个怪物曾经是一名士兵。它失去了人类的所有特征，隐藏在仿佛有生命的阴影中。它的移动方式不可思议的优雅和灵动。

monsters.name: military police zombie
monsters.desc: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.  Over its uniform is a vest reading "military police".

monsters.name: zombie soldier test only
monsters.desc: This zombie soldier is used by hardcoded dps logic and for testing purposes only.

monsters.name: 吐酸丧尸
monsters.desc: 一个弯腰驼背的丧尸，他的面部下垂，大部分的皮肤都有皱褶，几乎半透明，身上慢慢滴下病态的黄色液体。

monsters.name: 小穴居者丧尸
monsters.desc: 这个蜷缩着的变异小孩的脸上长着一对巨大的黑眼睛，它的指尖末端有着锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: 静电丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具非常苍白的尸体，长着你所见过的最糟糕的带电头发。电火花偶尔从它身上射出来，在黑暗中点亮它。你也许不该徒手或是用任何导电的物体触摸它。

monsters.name: 幸存者丧尸
monsters.desc: 一具穿着破旧的自制装甲，武器仍旧挂在身上的丧尸，看样子他曾经也是与你一样的幸存者。

monsters.name: 资深幸存者丧尸
monsters.desc: 这个丧尸曾经是一个像你一样的幸存者，而且是一个相当优秀的幸存者。但是，他们没有一直幸运下去。现在他们仍穿着生前自制的重型盔甲和装备。

monsters.name: zombie survivor test only
monsters.desc: This zombie survivor is used by hardcoded dps logic and for testing purposes only.

monsters.name: SWAT丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸曾经是一个特别执法行动部门的成员。它仍然穿着一件破旧的护甲，上面印有SWAT特警的标志。防护面具使它的头部成为难以攻击的目标，但也能防止它咬你。

monsters.name: ERT zombie
monsters.desc: This armored zombie wears the battered insignia of a Canadian police Emergency Response Team.

monsters.name: FERI zombie
monsters.desc: This armored zombie once served in the Mexican National Guard's Fuerza Especial de Reacción e Intervención.

monsters.name: 带蹼丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只穿着泳装、浑身皮肤光滑闪亮的丧尸。它的手和脚都变异成厚蹼，这表明它也许快速进化适应了水生生活。

monsters.name: 泳装丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只穿着泳衣的丧尸。可能不再是一个优雅的游泳运动员了。

monsters.name: 技术员丧尸
monsters.desc: Still wearing its work clothes and hardhat, this zombie likely used to work on power lines or other electrical equipment.

monsters.name: 荆棘蹒跚者
monsters.desc: 蹒跚的人形不死生物，身上长满了纠缠成团的异界植物，只能驼着背拖着脚行动。随着它的行动，完全包裹了它上半身的荆棘似乎活着一般，不断抽搐蠕动，卷弄着致人麻痹的尖刺。

monsters.name: 健壮丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸曾经是一名运动员，如今成为了凶残的丧尸怪物。它面孔扭曲，每一个毛孔都释放出纯粹的破坏欲望。

monsters.name: dusted tough zombie
monsters.desc: This muscular moving corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

monsters.name: fungal bulk
monsters.desc: This terrifying fungal construct seems to have lost all facial features, its face covered in thick fungal sprouts.  Its arms end in jagged points as fungal tendrils burst forth.

monsters.name: fungal stalk bulk
monsters.desc: This muscular corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

monsters.name: 锈刺丧尸
monsters.desc: 一只浑身长满锈刺的恐怖丧尸。一个等待发生的会行走的破伤风感染。

monsters.name: 哀嚎流浪儿
monsters.desc: 亡灵并没有善待末日的孩子们。这只小怪物就仅有复活的膜状皮肤包裹着微小脆弱的骨头。

monsters.name: 蝠翼丧尸
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸的手臂已经拉伸到超出了人类极限，连皮肤都被绷成惊悚的肉膜。突变显然与它不甚契合：相比其他丧尸，它动作更显笨拙，但偶尔能突然跳出一段相当长的距离。

monsters.name: fungal stalk wretch
monsters.desc: This small child lies on the ground smiling serenely, a short stalk of gray fungus bursting triumphantly from the top of the little head.  The chest of the child appears to have br

monsters.name: 可怖呕吐者
monsters.desc: 一具蹒跚移动的腐化尸体。各种各样的垃圾和废料已经融化成从皮肤上不断渗出的黑色黏液。

monsters.name: 丧尸改造人
monsters.desc: 一具早已死亡的人类和更致命的技术的混合体，这具钢铁和血肉扭曲在一起的躯体就像一个愤怒的幼童手中的木偶。它的机械部件似乎已经失效关闭，而新生的肌肉包裹在它们周围，把它们牵扯拉伸向奇怪的方向。一些金属骨架和盔甲从它腐烂的肉体中突出来。

monsters.name: zomborg devourer
monsters.desc: Human bodies, robots, and cybernetic enhancements fused together into a colossus, with heads and limbs both biological and robotic sticking out of its bloated body at grotesque ang

monsters.name: giant zombie treefrog
monsters.desc: The pale, empty eyes of this large, reanimated treefrog still swivel in their sockets, searching for prey.  Its steps are ungainly but its hind legs look capable of great leaps.

monsters.name: 丧尸公牛
monsters.desc: 曾经是一头家养的公牛，这只巨大且速度惊人的怪物长着黑色油光的眼睛和可怕的尖角。即便是活生生的公牛也会喜怒无常，而如今难以掩盖的愤怒是它唯一的情绪。

monsters.name: giant zombie bullfrog
monsters.desc: 这只大牛蛙身上覆盖的皮肤似乎从某些伤口上剥落，露出下面的黑色粘液。它空洞的目光掠过任何不是食物的东西，准备着跳起来吞噬任何食物。

monsters.name: 恐怖鹿角兽
monsters.desc: 这只曾经高贵强壮的驼鹿已经向正在毁灭世界的感染屈服。脱落的皮肤将化脓溃烂的血肉暴漏在外，滋生大量的绿头苍蝇。残余的毛皮则被腐败物染成了黑色。

monsters.name: 鹿角锤头兽
monsters.desc: 这只曾经体型巨大的驼鹿的眼睛渗出深色油状液体，被撕烈的血肉瘢痕累累。它全身上下布满了肿胀的肌肉和溃烂的伤口。

monsters.name: 荆棘蹒跚兽
monsters.desc: 曾经是一只体型巨大的驼鹿，现在被长而密的毛发所覆盖，上面缠绕着荆棘藤蔓，这些藤蔓缠绕在一起包裹着它的尸体。长长的刺缠绕在鹿角上，某种银色液体从尖端滴下来。

monsters.name: 腐朽突袭兽
monsters.desc: 一条看似正常的美洲狮，但仔细观察会发现它的后腿肿了，眼睛凸起并流着黑色的粘液。

monsters.name: fungal pouncer
monsters.desc: This four legged, oversized cat seems to spew spores from its pawpads with each clumsy landing, as if constantly gaining and losing balance in air.

monsters.name: 矛猫猎手

monsters.name: 幽灵猫
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸怪物被一层不可思议的阴影所笼罩，看上去似如光线也拒绝去接触它一般。你唯一能够分辨出来的是一个步履蹒跚的大型猫科动物轮廓。

monsters.name: 丧尸牛
monsters.desc: 曾经是一头平静的母牛，这只皮革包裹的恐怖怪物蹒跚着，颤抖着。虽然奶牛没有天生的武器，但像这样又大又重的凶残丧尸奶牛仍然极其危险。

monsters.name: 颅骨野猪
monsters.desc: 这只丧尸野猪如同是活着的特别巨大的巨型生物标本一样。这只怪物体型有八到九英尺长，其中最引人注目的特征是，它獠牙上的珐琅质已经完全覆盖了正脸，留下了颅骨般的外观和深陷的眼孔。

monsters.desc: 这只怪物只会在程序测试状态存在。
